test.create_query: CREATE TABLE text_index_qcc (id UInt64, text String, INDEX idx(text) TYPE text(tokenizer = 'splitByNonAlpha')) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY id
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO text_index_qcc SELECT number, concat(arrayStringConcat(arrayMap(i -> concat('w', toString(cityHash64(number, i) % 1000000)), range(4)), ' '), if(number >= 9500000 AND number % 100 = 0, ' needle', '')) FROM numbers(10000000) SETTINGS max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000, max_insert_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 0, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT sum(id) FROM text_index_qcc WHERE text LIKE '%needl%' SETTINGS use_query_condition_cache = 1
